text:
claire_fin: Heads-up: spotted a mismatch on Aug invoices where CloudLedger lines for GPU hours were attributed to `misc-unlabeled` instead of the agreed cost-centers. Total delta ~ $6,540. Need quick triage and provisional ledger hold so month-end closes cleanly.

henry_ops: Do we have invoice IDs and sample rows? I can trace ingest_id and backfill.

claire_fin: Uploaded sample and full export: gs://billing-backfills/2024-08-invoice-mismatch-2175.csv. Sample rows below. Will need a provisional allocation until vendor confirms whether these were our mis-tagging or CloudLedger duplicate lines.

Sample:
```
invoice_id,line_id,amount,orig_center,desired_allocation
CL-20240821,321,245.00,misc-unlabeled,platform:0.5;search:0.5
CL-20240821,322,130.00,misc-unlabeled,platform:0.5;search:0.5
```

jules_platform: Quick log check: ingest shows invoice CL-20240821 recorded twice with different ingest_ids; second record has no team metadata because a downstream transform failed on 2024-08-21T02:12Z. I can add a transient rule to map `misc-unlabeled` for that invoice to 50/50.

marta_search: Product OK with 50/50 provisional as long as customer-facing invoices aren't affected. Finance, any external credit exposure?

claire_fin: Customer-impact check: none. These are infra GPU bills (no pass-through). Confirming internal-only. We'll mark ledger entries as `vendor_hold` until procurement gets vendor confirmation. Total to allocate = $6,540.00.

procurement-bot: Procurement notified CloudLedger (ticket CL-5509) with invoice reference. Requesting validation of duplicate/ingest issues. Procurement POC: procurement@redwood.ai.

henry_ops: Proposed command to tag rows into a provisional file: `python infra/tools/tag_hold.py --input gs://billing-backfills/2024-08-invoice-mismatch-2175.csv --hold-tag vendor_hold --alloc "platform:0.5;search:0.5" --out gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-08-invoice-mismatch-2175-result.csv`

billing-bot: Billing pipeline: reprocess job queued (#99999) by henry_ops. ETA ~20m. Output: gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-08-invoice-mismatch-2175-result.csv

jules_platform: I'll also open a small ingest guard to reject duplicate invoice_id+line_id combinations: `ingest/invoice_dedupe.py` PR. Prevents double-counting in the future.

billing-bot: Job #99999 completed. Summary: 10 lines re-tagged, total held = $6,540.00. Output: gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-08-invoice-mismatch-2175-result.csv

claire_fin: Creating ledger PR with provisional allocations and audit note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ledger/pull/412. Includes before/after sample and `vendor_hold` tag. Tagging @jules_platform and @marta_search for approval. Accounting codes: PLATFORM-CORE, SEARCH-TEAM.

marta_search: Reviewed PR. Product approves provisional 50/50 allocation. Please ensure rollback steps if vendor issues a credit.

jules_platform: Approved. PR also references ingest guard PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/912 which blocks duplicates and adds a unit test.

procurement-bot: CloudLedger acknowledged ticket CL-5509. They will validate logs and reply within 4 business days. Procurement will notify finance on any credit.

claire_fin: Merged ledger PR and posted entries as `vendor_hold`. Will monitor for vendor reply and update monthly finance memo. Closing thread unless vendor issues a credit or teams see anomalies. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
